svg.title: 3. Prototype data flow: review, evaluate, then plan inspections
svg.desc: Saved bead images are counted and reviewed. QA records are entered separately with stage and outcome context; there is no automatic image-to-QA link. A recorded study supports a small numeric model and held-out baseline comparisons. Inspection priorities are rule-based, with human decisions and audit exports.

g.text: Review observations, evaluate the model, and plan inspections with human decisions.

g.title: photo to counter
counter to review
review to qa: manual entry; no automatic link
qa to study
study to model
model to evaluation
qa to planning: condition / completeness / age
study to planning: optional study evidence
evaluation to planning: optional historical context; scores do not rank the queue
g.text: Scores do not rank the queue

g.title: evaluation to export
planning to export
Saved image [current] Generated bead proxy / user photo
Pixel counter [current] Vercel CPU or browser worker Not a trained larvae detector
Human image review [current] Accept / correct / reject Retain estimate and review history
Container QA record [current] Dated stage counts and conditions Outcome assessed separately
Study plan + pinned snapshot [current] Unit / target / reference / missingness
Numeric model [experimental] Later failed vs satisfactory QA Use earlier observations only
Held-out evaluation [current] Grouped / chronological partition Two baselines + failure recall
Inspection queue [current] Rules + available evidence Human accept / defer / dismiss
Reviewable exports [current] Pinned inputs / methods / versions Reasons and decision history

g.text: Dashed route: contextual evidence, not automated ranking. Case charts are separate synthetic context.
Model results demonstrate an evaluation pipeline; they do not establish useful field prediction.
